iphoneTest.start: Set DAILY_PREVIEW_HOST to the computer's private Wi-Fi IPv4 address, then run node tests/serve-category-phone.cjs. Loopback is the default. Public and wildcard binds are rejected.
iphoneTest.use: Keep the computer awake and connect the iPhone to the same Wi-Fi. Open http://<computer-private-ip>:8795/ in Safari and choose Open sample app.
